scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:js: eslint js tests tooling build.js eslint.config.js stylelint.config.js
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:js -- --fix && npm run lint:css -- --fix && npm run lint:html
scripts.format: prettier --write index.html html css js tests tooling build.js eslint.config.js stylelint.config.js package.json .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html html css js tests tooling build.js eslint.config.js stylelint.config.js package.json .prettierrc.json README.md
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
